item.description:
### Improved - **Agent filters stay as chips.** With many agents running, the filter chips above the session list now scroll sideways instead of turning into a menu, so you can always see which filter is on.
### Fixed - **No stale Devin alert after Perch restarts.** If you answered or cancelled a Devin permission prompt while Perch was closed, Perch no longer says it needs you when it opens again.
